newsitem.title: USA: Comcast sees losses from digital venture.
newsitem.headline: Comcast sees losses from digital venture.

text.p: Comcast Corp said Monday it foresees more start-up losses from its participation in the digital wireless venture Sprint PCS.
The cable and telecommunications company reported a net loss of $0.20 a share for the first quarter, compared to a loss of $0.14 for the same period last year.
It blamed the wider loss on financial costs and non-cash charges like depreciation and amortization, as well as equity in net losses of affiliates.
"The company's proportionate share of these (Sprint PCS) start-up losses, which is expected to be significant in future periods, is included in equity in net losses of affiliates," it said.
Comcast reported $70.1 million as equity in net losses of affiliates for the first quarter, compared to $34.5 million a year ago.
Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate.

Comcast has a 15 percent interest in the venture, a digital wireless phone network that is considered to be the successor to the cellular network. Sprint Corp and another company are the other participants in the venture.
